## Summary

Bergeron et al. (2023) reported 40-fold variation in vertebrate per-generation
mutation rates across primates and rodents, identifying generation time, age at
maturity, fecundity, and effective population size as important predictors.
The cross-species fit is consistent with a roughly Ne^-0.6 scaling.

- claim_drift_barrier: supports
